title: Restaurant, cloud kitchen or packaged-food brand
tagline: From a home kitchen on Swiggy to a café or a snack brand on shelves — food has its own licence stack.
who: Packaged food, beverage and nutraceutical brands

structure.recommended: Proprietorship for a single outlet or home kitchen; private limited for a brand or multi-outlet chain
structure.why: A single kitchen runs fine as a proprietorship with FSSAI registration and GST (composition at 5% is popular for restaurants). A packaged brand or a chain needs a company for trademarks, investors and franchise agreements.
structure.alternatives: LLP for partner-run cafés that will not raise equity.

breakdown: Trade licence + eating-house licence (police, some cities) + signage: ₹2,000–25,000
Music licence (PPL/IPRS) if you play music: ₹5,000–40,000/yr

timeline: FSSAI registration within a week, licence 2–4 weeks; Swiggy/Zomato onboarding 3–10 days after FSSAI; a café’s municipal permits 3–8 weeks.
taxes: Restaurants: 5% GST without input credit (composition at 5% of turnover up to ₹1.5 crore, or regular 5% rate); 18% with ITC only in specified hotel premises. Delivery platforms pay GST on restaurant services themselves (ECO liable under s.9(5)) — you still need registration above threshold.
Packaged food: GST by HSN (mostly 5% or 18% after the 2025 rationalisation; branded vs unbranded distinctions matter).
Income tax: proprietor slabs; presumptive 6%/8% up to ₹3 crore possible for traders/manufacturers.
Swiggy/Zomato deduct 0.1% TDS (194-O) and collect GST TCS where applicable; reconcile weekly settlements.
selling: Swiggy, Zomato, ONDC food apps (Magicpin, Paytm)
Retail: kirana and modern trade for packaged goods; quick commerce via distributors
sourcing: APMC mandis and wholesale markets; Metro/Udaan/Jumbotail for B2B groceries; packaging from Daryaganj/Sadar (Delhi) or Alibaba
Co-packers for a food brand must hold their own FSSAI licence; your label still carries your FSSAI number as brand owner
pitfalls: Operating on an FSSAI *registration* when turnover or kind of business needs a *licence* (e.g., any importer or e-commerce food seller needs Central).
Labels without FSSAI logo and number, veg/non-veg mark, nutrition panel, allergen and date marking — FSSAI labelling regulations are enforced online too.
Choosing composition then selling through a marketplace inter-state or issuing tax invoices — not allowed.
No fire NOC or eating-house licence in cities that require them (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru) — sealing risk.
Health certificates and medical fitness for food handlers, pest-control records and water testing skipped until an inspection.
